meta_title: D. Herbert Plumbing & Heating | Plumber Luton
meta_description: D. Herbert Plumbing and Heating in Luton. Emergency repairs, boiler installations, and heating maintenance. Same-day service available. Call now.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe or broken boiler in Luton? We arrive within the hour, any time of day or night.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing and Heating Services Across Luton
services_subhead: From emergency callouts to planned maintenance, we handle every plumbing and heating job with speed and skill.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blockages fixed fast. We carry parts on the van and aim to resolve most issues on the first visit, day or night.

services.title: Boiler Installation and Replacement
services.desc: New gas boiler fitted and commissioned with a 10-year warranty. We'll survey your home, explain your options, and handle the lot from start to finish.

services.title: Boiler Repair and Servicing
services.desc: Annual servicing keeps your boiler running safely and efficiently. Faults diagnosed and repaired quickly—most jobs done same day without faffing around.

services.title: Central Heating System Installation
services.desc: Full heating system design and installation, including radiators, pipework, and controls. We'll modernise an old system or fit a new one tailored to your home.

services.title: Radiator Installation and Repairs
services.desc: Cold radiators, leaks, or upgrades handled properly. We balance systems, bleed air, and fit new rads with all pipework neatly hidden where possible.

services.title: Plumbing Maintenance and Upgrades
services.desc: New taps, showers, toilet repairs, and general plumbing work. We sort minor niggles before they become expensive emergencies.

about_pullquote: I started this because I was tired of seeing people ripped off by cowboys.
about_para_1: D. Herbert Plumbing and Heating has been serving Luton homeowners and businesses for over 12 years. We're Gas Safe Registered and insured, with a reputation built on showing up when we say we will and fixing things properly the first time. What started as a one-man operation has grown because customers keep recommending us to their friends and family.
about_para_2: We're not the cheapest, but we're fair. We turn up on time, we explain what's wrong in plain English, and we don't upsell you stuff you don't need. That's why so many Luton homes trust us with their heating and plumbing—and why we get called back again and again.
reviews_heading: What Luton Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a nightmare with a leaking radiator before Christmas. Dave came out the same evening and had it sorted in 45 minutes. Brilliant bloke, fair price. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Called them on a Saturday morning with a burst pipe in the kitchen. They were here by lunchtime. Very professional, explained everything clearly, and didn't charge extra for the weekend call. Top job.
reviews.author: Sarah M.

reviews.text: New boiler fitted from start to finish without any hassle. The engineer was knowledgeable, tidy, and answered all my questions. Ten-year warranty gives me peace of mind. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: James P.
